purpose: Resource shortlist for Finnish YKI + future app. Only source links and metadata, no copyrighted content duplicated.

rights_policy.IMPORT_CC_BY_4_WITH_CREDITS: Копіювати з власними notices/author upstream; дотримуватися CC BY 4.0
rights_policy.LINK_ONLY_YLE_RIGHTS: Не копіювати завдання/аудіо Yle; оригінальні URL
rights_policy.LINK_ONLY_TERMS_UNCONFIRMED: Посилання, без перепублікації до перевірки прав
rights_policy.API_PER_CORPUS_RIGHTS: Право залежить від корпусу; не автоматизувати масове копіювання
rights_policy.IMPORT_TEXT_CC_BY_2_FR_WITH_AUTHOR_ID_OR: Кожне речення з атрибуцією та QC; аудіо окремо
rights_policy.GPL_3_COMPONENT_REQUIRES_ARCHITECTURE_RE: Не включати напряму в пропрієтарний клієнт без legal review
rights_policy.CC_BY_4_REUSE_WITH_CREDIT: Reuse CC BY material with author/source/notice attribution and third-party content exclusions.
rights_policy.CC_BY_ND_4_LINK_ONLY: Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0; link and unchanged redistribution with credits where permitted.
rights_policy.CC_BY_4_DIRECT_MEDIA_403_NOT_IMPORTED: Rights appear CC BY but automated media retrieval failed; catalog only, no local asset.
rights_policy.CC_BY_SA_4_CHECK_EACH_LINKED_ITEM: Verify sub-asset rights, provide credits, honor share-alike terms for derivatives.
rights_policy.OFFICIAL_PDF_LINK_ONLY: Official exam criteria for reference; separate permission needed before repository redistribution.
rights_policy.CC_BY_4_WRAPPER_THIRD_PARTY_NEWS_RIGHTS_: The exercise page is CC BY but contains adapted news text; do not redistribute embedded news article until rights checked.
rights_policy.CC_BY_4_PHOTOS_EXCLUDED: Text marked CC BY; images excluded due separate all-rights-reserved language.
rights_policy.IMPORT_CC_BY_4_WITH_CREDIT_AND_SOURCE_NO: CC BY 4.0: retain FIN-CLARIN and VISK source credits, mark selection and cloze transformations; teacher review before scored use.
rights_policy.CC_BY_SA_4_REVIEW_ALL_SOURCE_NOTICES: ShareAlike constraints, extra sources attribution, rights check before app distribution.
rights_policy.CC_BY_ND_PRIV_PERSONAL_DATA_LINK_RESEARC: No adaptation/republication of ND audio/transcripts, plus personal data obligations; only research links.
rights_policy.PUBLIC_DATA_BUT_VERSION_LICENSE_TO_CONFI: Resource group is public, exact per-version license must be checked; no import until confirmed.
rights_policy.RESTRICTED_VARIANTS_PERSONAL_DATA_NO_IMP: Access varies by subcorpus and personal data restrictions; do not import learner samples.
rights_policy.LINK_ONLY_UNDERLYING_TEXT_RIGHTS_MIXED: Annotation and underlying text rights differ; never bulk-import underlying content on annotation license alone.
rights_policy.CC_BY_NC_ND_LINK_ONLY: NonCommercial and NoDerivatives apply; no commercial app redistribution or transformations.
rights_policy.LINK_ONLY_CHECK_EACH_SUBRESOURCE: Directory license does not authorize copying every linked material.
